content.short: Capricorn Tech, formerly aPriori, pairs order flow coordination with liquid staking on Monad.
content.description: Capricorn Tech, which launched as aPriori, runs an order flow coordination layer for high-throughput chains together with a Monad liquid staking product built on top of it, routing value captured from transaction ordering back to stakers. Delegators stake MON and receive a liquid token usable elsewhere while the underlying stake keeps earning. The staking product holds over twenty-five million MON, and the same interface covers bridging, swapping and locking. Its documentation still carries the aPriori name.
content.meta: Monad liquid staking from Capricorn Tech, formerly aPriori, with ordering revenue returned to stakers.
